description: This file defines an interface 'CommandStrategy' which declares a method 'execute' to process batch requests within the Fineract project. It sets a contract for different command strategy implementations to return batch responses based on input requests and URI information.

classes.name: CommandStrategy
classes.description: An interface for various Command Strategies. It contains a single method 'execute' that takes a BatchRequest and UriInfo, returning a BatchResponse.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Defines a method that processes a BatchRequest with associated URI information and returns a BatchResponse.
